description.en: Shows a monologue: centred text with no speech window and no speaker, on the given screen (CMND_MESSAGE_OPEN(_id, true, true, false, 0, false, _drawScreen)); it then waits with suspend() until CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE() is false, that is until the player has read and closed the message.
Screen to draw on, e.g. SCREEN_A.

examples.case: An inner monologue during a scene (real usage, from ev44020015.nut)
